item_short_desc: Stay powered up wherever you go with Rothco’s Waterproof Solar Power Bank. Built with a robust ABS plastic body and equipped with a 5V/1.2W monocrystalline cell solar panel, this power bank ensures reliable energy storage in all weather conditions. The 3.7V 5000mAh battery features dual USB outputs and a 5V 1000mAh input, making it compatible with high-end electronic devices. Its quick charge lithium polymer battery provides efficient and fast charging for your gadgets.
description: Stay powered up wherever you go with Rothco’s Waterproof Solar Power Bank. Built with a robust ABS plastic body and equipped with a 5V/1.2W monocrystalline cell solar panel, this power bank ensures reliable energy storage in all weather conditions. The 3.7V 5000mAh battery features dual USB outputs and a 5V 1000mAh input, making it compatible with high-end electronic devices. Its quick charge lithium polymer battery provides efficient and fast charging for your gadgets. For added convenience, the power bank comes with a carabiner, allowing you to securely attach it to your backpack or bag while on the move. It also includes a micro USB charging cable. Please note, due to hazmat restrictions, this item cannot be shipped via air freight and may have other shipping limitations. For more information, contact Rothco. Whether you’re hiking, camping, or traveling, Rothco’s Waterproof Solar Power Bank is the perfect companion to keep your devices charged and ready.
